UNITED STATES
NUCLEAR REGULATORY COMMISSION
WASHINGTON, D. C. 20125
I E COMMISSION
OCT * * 1975
Kenneth F. Plumb, Secretary Federal Power Commission Washington, D. C. 20426
Dear Mr. Plumb:
This is in response to your letter of September 30, 1975 inviting our comments on the Draft Environmental Impact Statement prepared by your staff in connection with the application for a license filed by the Duke Power Company for the proposed Bad Creek Pumped Storage Project No. 2740.
We have reviewed the statement and determined that the proposed action has meither radiological health and safety impacts nor will it adversely affect any activities subject to regulation by the Nuclear Regulatory Commission. We would, however, like to comment on the statement as follows. We are of the opinion that Section 8, Alternatives to the Proposed Action, is extremely well written. The section on pumped storage facilities is instructional to anyone interested in their use and, in particular, their importance to the reliability and efficiency of the Duke Power Company System. In addition, the overall treatment of alternatives is excellent.
Thank you for providing us with the opportunity to review this Draft Environmental Impact Statement.
Sincerely,
Daniel R. Muller, Assistant Director for Environmental Projects
Division of Reactor Licensing
Danul R Windle
